2094|28b1f157.name: James Halloran
2094|28b1f157.text: Greetings, $c. I'm in a bit of a pinch right now, running very low on hides.

471-progress.name: James Halloran
471-progress.text:
My apprentice is like a son to me. It's going to be hard for him to live his life with only one leg.

Ah, $N, how goes it?  Do you have my skins?
471-progress.title: Apprentice's Duties

98072-accept.name: James Halloran
98072-accept.text:
You're quite the go-getter! I have just one more favor to ask, if you're up for something a bit more dangerous.

The crocolisk trade is steady money, but they're small fish compared to what whelp scales will bring. Folks will pay top dollar for a sack of those.

Crocs of the sky, I call 'em! There's no way my apprentice could get them--but it seems right up your alley!

You'll find whelps far to the east, along the Green Belt. But be careful, there's nasty orcs in those hills!
98072-accept.title: Crocs of the Sky
